$schema: Source of truth for MAAC Adabari design tokens. Consolidates design-system/*.md after Phase 0 reconciliation fixes (container widths, spacing-scale, card color, contrast). Feeds tailwind.config.ts theme.extend. Do not hand-edit tailwind.config.ts values that originate here without updating this file first.

_notes.surface: Canonical #111111. design-system/01-colors.md's Neutral Palette->Surface previously said #1A1A1A, conflicting with the same file's Component Colors->Cards and Tailwind Tokens->Surface (both #111111) — #111111 wins, doc fixed to match.
_notes.text.muted: Raised 0.50 -> 0.60 for WCAG AA contrast (was borderline ~4.5:1 on the #111111 card surface; now ~6.8:1 everywhere).
_notes.text.disabled: 0.30 fails 4.5:1 (~2.53:1 on #050505). Documented, scoped WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 exemption — apply ONLY to elements with a native disabled attribute or aria-disabled="true", never to merely de-emphasized interactive text. See design-system/12-accessibility.md.

_notes.scale: min/max pairs are fluid type — implement with CSS clamp() in Tailwind config, not static text-{size} utility classes. design-system/02-typography.md's own 'Tailwind Tokens' table maps each heading to one static class, which loses the fluid range entirely; that table is retained in the doc as a rough reference only, not as implementation guidance.

Map these into tailwind.config.ts theme.extend.spacing under these exact names (xs/sm/md/lg/xl/2xl/3xl/4xl). Do NOT rely on Tailwind's bare numeric spacing utilities (p-32, gap-16, etc.) — design-system/03-spacing.md previously documented a numeric-alias table that was exactly half of Tailwind's real default scale (e.g. claimed space-32=64px; real Tailwind space-32=128px). Named tokens make that bug structurally impossible.

_notes.general: Exactly 3 containers site-wide, per design-system/04-layout-grid.md (canonical). Previously design-system/03-spacing.md and design-system/13-responsive.md each defined extra, conflicting tiers (1024px/1280px) that existed nowhere else — removed. Breakpoint->container mapping: mobile/tablet=fluid 100%; laptop/desktop=default(1200px); largeDesktop=wide(1440px). Only padding varies across laptop vs desktop.

_notes.content: Content-grid columns (cards/features per row) are a distinct concept from the structural 12/8/4-column grid above — a 4-column content grid is 4 equal spans within the 12-column structural grid, not a contradiction. See design-system/13-responsive.md -> Grid Rules.

_notes.general: Fixed glow opacity mismatch: design-system/01-colors.md's Glow Colors->Primary Glow (rgba(229,57,53,0.45)) previously disagreed with design-system/10-effects.md's Primary Glow Opacity (0.30) for the same value — 0.45 is now canonical everywhere.

_notes.library: design-system/08-icons.md names Heroicons as a 'secondary' library alongside Lucide as primary. Per the confirmed Next.js/React tech-stack decision, standardize on Lucide only — do not mix icon libraries in the same component tree.
